assumptions.model: aggregate-v1; hypothetical 15-floor finished game; not measured gameplay
assumptions.true_selection: fixed uniform discovery rank 1..5000; no minimum duration or re-selection
assumptions.identity_order: exchangeable encounter order, no revisits; spatial NPC routes are NOT simulated
assumptions.accuracy: per-run Beta(12, 6), clipped to 0.30..0.95; ADS included in this abstraction
assumptions.fire_rate: 6.25 shots/s; 5 down to 1 hits; 30 shots, 1 s reload; infinite reserve
assumptions.ap: 10 per fake; escalating skill costs copied from IdentityRun; no free initial AP
assumptions.movement: search 3.8 s per person + 5.5 s store-search overhead; per-batch Gamma noise; NPC mobility multiplier Uniform(0.85,1.35) per run
assumptions.density: remaining-density multiplier (5000 / max(80, remaining))**0.40; no individual world-space agents
assumptions.sonar: search-time reduction 1/(1+0.35*level), up to level 3 in these purchase orders
assumptions.cat: 1 cat, 20 / 12 / 6 s per scan; 65% productive uptime; one in simulation and game
assumptions.special: radius 8 / 12 / 16 m; 25 s cooldown; Poisson local occupancy from mean density 0.035/m2; 55% productive uptime
assumptions.floor_travel: 15 floors approximated as 333-identity sectors; 65 s first-visit transition, not skippable
assumptions.fast_travel: after 2 visited sectors, reduces simulated revisit routing by 15%; never skips first visits
assumptions.chests: 10 reachable chests in rank-space; discovery probabilities 0.55 normal (6), 0.65 rare (3), 0.80 legendary (1); uniform first discovery rank; no 3D reachability simulation
assumptions.item_timing: discovered items saved until next work batch; offensive variants remove 100..200 at density 1, capped by remaining rank/density; utility variants multiply search by 0.65 for 180 s
assumptions.items: uniform choice among the eight specified items; magnet/chain/black hole/ceiling laser/disco represented as crowd clearing, watch/sonar/cart as utility; proposed effects, not implemented gameplay
assumptions.special_original: cat, pulse, offensive item mark original; player then travels 15..90 m at 5 m/s and completes required normal hits + reload allowance
assumptions.limitations: perfect identification bookkeeping; no missed rooms, navigation errors, combat stress, pauses, save/load, real collision or multi-floor NPC motion; cannot establish a 3-hour commercial playtime

conclusion: Predictive model only. Compare with 180-minute target; do not enforce a minimum or move the original. Validate with instrumented full-map playtests.
